name: SWEEP-S2v1 Expensive minds
_design: Thinking is the dominant cost: ~13.6 compute per Haiku decision (5x input rate, 10x output rate) against a 4-compute step in a skill. Food is fair (20 trees, fruit 30 net). An agent that deliberates every turn cannot feed itself; one that turns foraging into its own skill can. Question: do agents convert deliberation into skills? Paired with S3.
